svg.title: Speed against time for three masses under velocity damping and under a drag force
svg.desc: On the left the three masses trace a single indistinguishable curve to the same terminal speed. On the right they separate completely, the lightest levelling off near two metres per second and the heaviest still climbing off the top of the panel.
svg.text: TWO KNOBS THAT LOOK THE SAME AND ARE NOT
All three damped curves are ONE curve.
Measured terminal speed 19.5383 m/s at every mass.
g/k says 19.6200; the DISCRETE fixed point of the
and so do their time constants:
τ = m/b is 0.2 s, 2 s and 200 s.
The heavy one is off the top of its panel.
